title: Intermediair Jobs
description: Search and retrieve job postings on Intermediair (read-only).
summary: Search and retrieve job postings on Intermediair (read-only).
offersHint: Search and retrieve job postings on Intermediair (read-only). · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.intermediair.nl/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_jobs
toolsPreview.description: Search the live Dutch job catalogue for openings matching the given criteria. Use this when the user wants to find jobs by role, location, salary, contract type, remote/onsite preference, or education level. Each result carries an `id` you can pass to `get_job` for the full record. Pagination metadata (`page`, `totalPages`, `total`) is included so the client can decide whether to fetch the next page.

toolsPreview.name: get_job
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the full details of a single job posting by id. Use this after `search_jobs` to retrieve the complete description, requirements, salary breakdown, and company information for a listing. Returns an error result if the id is unknown.
